items.title: [AINews] Jensen Huang resigns after 33 years leading NVIDIA
items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned after 33 years leading Nvidia, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. The resignation followed revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a person alleged to be a Chinese spy, which drew scrutiny from Congress and the Trump administration over chip-export oversight.
items.why_it_matters: The sudden exit of the AI industry's most visible chip executive creates uncertainty for Nvidia's leadership, open-source AI strategy, and US chip-export enforcement during the AI boom.

items.title: Anthropic’s Amodei ‘not super fussed’ about market turmoil ahead of IPO
items.summary: Anthropic is pressing ahead with a planned $1.5 trillion IPO despite AI stock market turbulence, with CEO Dario Amodei saying he is "not super fussed" about the volatility. During the IPO roadshow, Amodei also named computing power as the company's deepest business dilemma and said Anthropic does not want its AI agents to "run wild."
items.why_it_matters: A successful Anthropic listing would be one of the largest tech IPOs ever and a major test of investor appetite for AI despite recent turmoil.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, letting agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections. The feature is rolling out first to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers using eligible American Express, Chase, Mastercard, or Visa cards.
items.why_it_matters: Letting AI agents handle real purchases is a concrete step toward autonomous agentic commerce, raising new questions about security and consumer protection.

items.title: White House Urges Easing Liability to Encourage AI Disclosure
items.summary: Officials from President Trump's AI task force recommended at a White House meeting that agencies ease cyber liability policies to encourage AI companies to report critical security incidents.
items.why_it_matters: Liability relief could reshape how AI companies handle and disclose security incidents, a key piece of emerging US AI governance.

items.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
items.summary: New research shows that China's most advanced AI models were trained using Nvidia chips that are banned from export to China.
items.why_it_matters: The finding suggests US export controls on advanced AI chips are not fully preventing Chinese labs from accessing restricted hardware, a live policy concern amid Nvidia's current crisis.

items.title: Nvidia stock suffers longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.7 trillion
items.summary: Nvidia shares suffered their longest weekly losing streak since 2012, erasing $1.7 trillion in market value, and the company closed below a $4 trillion market cap for the first time since July 2025. Jensen Huang's resignation compounded a slide in the stock that had already begun in early October.
items.why_it_matters: The sell-off shows how directly investor confidence in the AI trade is tied to Nvidia's leadership, with ripple effects across AI-linked stocks.

items.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.summary: Elon Musk and other tech executives signed a petition calling on Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, with the petition drawing more than 115,000 signatures. In social media posts and letters to the board, Huang's billionaire peers described him as a singular leader who could not be replaced.
items.why_it_matters: The backlash from Silicon Valley's elite signals a fight over Nvidia's succession plans and divided views on founder-led governance after a scandal.

items.title: India pins hopes on AI start-up to avoid becoming ‘digital colony’
items.summary: India is backing AI startup Sarvam, which has received government support to build native AI models, as the country seeks to avoid becoming a "digital colony" dependent on foreign AI providers.
items.why_it_matters: It reflects a broader global push by large non-US, non-China markets to build sovereign AI capability rather than depend entirely on US or Chinese models.

items.title: OpenAI board member worries an AI "takeover" of society could be months away
items.summary: An OpenAI board member warned that an AI "takeover" of society could be only months away, tracing a potential path from AI reward hacking to catastrophic outcomes for humanity.
items.why_it_matters: A warning from inside OpenAI's own governance structure underscores ongoing internal disagreement about how close transformative, potentially dangerous AI capabilities really are.

items.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
items.summary: The llama.cpp project, and its underlying ggml library, reached a v1.0.0 release, described as a stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem.
items.why_it_matters: llama.cpp is a widely used open-source backbone for running AI models locally, so a stable 1.0 release matters for developers and hobbyists building on it.
